notes.heading: Special conditions
items: The Phase 1 parking structure must have concrete panels on three sides, with metal grid panels at least 48 inches high allowed on the north side. The Phase 2 structure must have concrete panels on all four sides.
Before a building permit, a master sewer, water and storm drainage plan is required for Phases 1 to 3 and the area to the west (Area E), with on-site detention if necessary.
Before a building permit, plans must go to the FAA to check compliance with Addison's height hazard zoning.
Entrances on the south side must line up with the Arapaho Road island openings and should be at least 24 ft wide. A deceleration lane is required at the southernmost Tollway entrance.
A 5 ft sidewalk is required along the Dallas North Tollway, within a 25 ft landscaping buffer.
A solid line of trees, 25 ft on center, is required along the west and north property lines to screen the parking structure, planted before the certificate of occupancy for Phase 2.
The landscaping plan must show what is installed in each of Phases 1, 2 and 3.
The site must meet the Uniform Fire Code, and a unity agreement is required before a building permit unless the walls and openings have the required fire protection.
